title: Fixing MATLAB Error 5201
text: Encountering MATLAB Error 5201 when trying to connect or use MATLAB services. This error typically occurs due to corrupted ServiceHost or MATLAB Connector configuration files.

title: Fixing MATLAB Error 5201
text: Encountering MATLAB Error 5201 when trying to connect or use MATLAB services. This error typically occurs due to corrupted ServiceHost or MATLAB Connector configuration files.

title: Fixing MATLAB Error 5201
text:
Solution
Remove the corrupted configuration directories:
rm -rf ~/.MathWorks/ServiceHost ~/.MATLABConnector

title: Fixing MATLAB Error 5201
text:
Explanation
This command removes: - ~/.MathWorks/ServiceHost: Contains ServiceHost configuration - ~/.MATLABConnector: Contains MATLAB Connector settings
MATLAB will recreate these directories with fresh configuration on next launch.

title: Fixing MATLAB Error 5201
text:
Steps

Close all MATLAB instances
Run the cleanup command
Restart MATLAB
The error should be resolved
